before.description: Public Fugaro images from ghcr.io, cached for this installation's builds and jobs
before.name: fugaro-synthetic-state-value

after.description: Public Fugaro images from ghcr.io, cached for this installation's builds and jobs

before.filter: ((resource.type="cloud_run_job" AND labels."fugaro"="managed") OR (resource.type="batch.googleapis.com/Job" AND labels."fugaro"="managed")) AND NOT (resource.labels.job_name=~"^fugarochk-" AND jsonPayload.event="image-check") AND NOT logName:"run.googleapis.com%2Fvarlog%2Fsystem"
before.name: fugaro-jobs-from-default

after.filter: ((resource.type="cloud_run_job" AND labels."fugaro"="managed") OR (resource.type="batch.googleapis.com/Job" AND labels."fugaro"="managed")) AND NOT (resource.labels.job_name=~"^fugarochk-" AND jsonPayload.event="image-check") AND NOT logName:"run.googleapis.com%2Fvarlog%2Fsystem"
after.name: fugaro-jobs-from-default
